papers.title_en: V-SHARE: Provable Convergence Guarantees for Advantage-based Algorithms
papers.authors: Kintan Saha, Hamed Masoudi, Xinyi Sheng, Dominik Baumann, Joni Pajarinen, Arsenii Mustafin
papers.evidence: 优势类价值学习及其收敛与有限样本保证
papers.tldr: 优势类价值学习将动作价值分解为状态价值与动作优势，通过跨动作共享信息，但其收敛理论仍不完整。论文提出V-SHARE，把跨动作价值共享与重要性加权贝尔曼残差修正相结合，并设计递减残差预条件调度和两时间尺度分析。作者首次给出该算法的渐近收敛与非渐近有限样本保证，识别其缓解异步Q学习稀有动作瓶颈的区域，并揭示确定性收缩与加权噪声间的收缩—方差权衡。离散MDP与深度强化学习基准实验验证了理论结果。
papers.abstract_en: In reinforcement learning, advantage-based value-learning methods, unlike standard Q-learning, share information across actions by decomposing the action-value function into a state-dependent value component and action-specific advantages. While this mechanism has proven effective in both tabular and deep reinforcement learning, its theoretical understanding remains incomplete. We introduce V-SHARE, an advantage-based value-learning algorithm that combines cross-action value sharing with an importance-weighted Bellman-residual correction. To our knowledge, we provide the first complete theoretical characterization of an advantage-based algorithm, including both asymptotic convergence and non-asymptotic finite-sample guarantees. We identify a regime in which V-SHARE mitigates the rare-action bottleneck of asynchronous Q-learning and uncover a contraction--variance tradeoff between stronger deterministic contraction and increased importance-weighting noise. Motivated by this tradeoff, we develop decreasing residual-preconditioning schedules that combine faster early contraction with lower asymptotic noise. We further develop a two-timescale analysis that removes the single-timescale residual-weight threshold while preserving convergence guarantees. Experiments on discrete Markov decision processes (MDPs) and deep reinforcement-learning benchmarks corroborate our results.

papers.title_en: BeJEPA: A Goal-Conditioned Humanoid Behavior World Model via Unsupervised RL
papers.authors: Liyun Yan, Haoyang Li, Yang Zhang, Jialing Zhu, Zhanxiang Cao, Zihao Zhou, Keqi Zhu, Yizhi Chen, Huang Chuxuan, Shengcheng Fu, Zhong Jiangwei, Qiao Sun, Chen Zhang, Yue Gao
papers.evidence: 用于人形机器人全身控制的无监督强化学习世界模型
papers.tldr: 人形控制需协调全身姿态与世界坐标位置、朝向，但主流根坐标系模仿在位移后难恢复目标世界位姿。BeJEPA 通过无监督强化学习从人体运动先验和机器人交互学习目标条件行为世界模型，以 JEPA 联合嵌入表征身体构型与世界放置。Dynamic Predictor 预测动作后状态嵌入，Successor Predictor 汇总目标策略的期望折扣未来嵌入；联合训练后，仅用一次物理预测和一次行为摘要指导策略改进。20 秒跟踪中，其全局身体位置误差较 BFM-Zero 降低 61.7%、较 SONIC 降低 58.7%，并在 Unitree G1 上实现姿态、世界位置与朝向目标及扰动后恢复。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid control requires coordinating whole-body posture with position and heading in the world frame. Mainstream controllers imitate trajectories in the root frame, but struggle to regain the target world pose after displacement. We introduce BeJEPA, a goal-conditioned Behavior World Model learned through unsupervised reinforcement learning from human motion priors and robot interaction. BeJEPA learns a shared representation of body configuration and world placement through a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). A Dynamic Predictor predicts the next state embedding under an action, while a Successor Predictor summarizes a goal-conditioned policy's expected discounted future state embeddings in a single vector. During joint training, Dynamic grounds the initial representation in observed physical transitions, while Successor increasingly organizes it around long-term behavior. Their composition guides policy improvement through one physical prediction and one behavioral summary, without long imagined rollouts. In 20-second motion-tracking experiments, BeJEPA with online action refinement using Dynamic outperforms all evaluated baselines in global body-position error, reducing it on AMASS by 61.7% relative to BFM-Zero with world-pose inputs and 58.7% relative to SONIC. Physical deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates joint attainment of posture, world position, and heading goals, recovery from the ground, and closed-loop return after disturbances and goal changes. Project page: https://ylyem9x.github.io/BeJEPA-project.

papers.title_en: Selective Growing Q-Networks (SGQN): An Analysis of Adaptive Action Grids in Decoupled Q-Learning
papers.authors: Parham Nooranbakht, Seyed Mahdi Basiri Azad, Joschka Bödecker
papers.evidence: 解耦Q学习值函数与自适应动作离散化
papers.tldr: 连续控制中基于值的Q学习需离散动作空间，分辨率在早期探索与最终精度间权衡。SGQN保留解耦Q学习，用自适应动作网格在高估值分箱旁加箱、剪除低估值箱，并以ε-greedy选动作。在8个DMControl任务（2–12维动作）上，4个任务最终平均回报最高，另3个距最佳≤1.1%，Walker Run低于Bang-Bang MPO 3.4%，平均每维用7.5/9箱。分析表明自适应网格并非收益主因，粗网格起步与ε-greedy更关键。
papers.abstract_en: Value-based Q-learning for continuous control can discretise the action space, but the resolution of the discretisation trades early exploration against final precision. Growing Q-Networks (GQN) grow the resolution uniformly from coarse to fine. We introduce Selective Growing Q-Networks (SGQN), which keeps decoupled Q-learning and replaces uniform growth with an adaptive action grid: bins are added next to bins with high estimated Q-value, bins with low Q-value are pruned, and actions are chosen epsilon-greedily. On eight DeepMind Control Suite (DMControl) tasks with 2 to 12 action dimensions, SGQN has the highest mean final return among the compared methods on four, is within 1.1% of the best method on three more, and is 3.4% below Bang-Bang MPO on Walker Run, using on average 7.5 of 9 available bins per dimension. We then test whether the adaptive grid explains these results, and find that it does not. Growth activates every candidate bin and behaves like uniform growth, and removing pruning changes the return by at most 1.1%. Two other choices matter: starting from a coarse grid, since starting with all 9 bins produces collapsed seeds, and epsilon-greedy selection, since an annealed softmax lowers the return by 23% to 100%. SGQN is insensitive to its growth and pruning hyperparameters. It also differs from the GQN and DecQN baselines in other respects, notably one gradient update per environment step instead of one per eight, which we did not control for, so we do not attribute its advantage to a single component. We present SGQN as a competitive value-based method and as an analysis of which ingredients of a growing action grid matter.

papers.title_en: KODA: Kinematics--Observation Data Alignment for Humanoid Learning from Human Egocentric Demonstration
papers.authors: Zibo Zhou, Yueru Chen, Junsong Wu, Weiji Xie, Qingyao Xu, Sheng Yin, Shiqing Wang, Jiyuan Shi, Siheng Chen, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li
papers.evidence: 从第一视角示范学习人形全身VLA策略
papers.tldr: 人形全身VLA训练依赖昂贵的机器人演示，而人类第一视角数据存在视角错位与动作稀疏问题。KODA用可复用的规范轨迹对齐运动与观测：先经仿真校验生成全身轨迹并确定机载相机位姿，合成机器人视角观测，再为不同控制器生成状态-动作监督。在Unitree G1四项移动操作任务上，固定机器人数据时，人类演示覆盖但机器人数据缺失条件下的宏平均成功率分别提升45.0和46.25个百分点，且随人类数据预算呈上升趋势。
papers.abstract_en: Training humanoid whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies requires costly robot demonstrations with aligned robot-view observations and controller-compatible whole-body state-action labels. Egocentric human demonstrations offer scalable supervision but have misaligned views and sparse motion cues. Existing approaches either pretrain policies that still require robot data for adaptation or generate controller-specific commands that limit reuse. Conversion also requires robot-view observations aligned with the generated whole-body motion. We present KODA (Kinematics-Observation Data Alignment), which converts egocentric RGB demonstrations into whole-body VLA training data using a reusable canonical trajectory to guide robot-view synthesis and generate controller-specific whole-body state-action supervision. KODA first generates a simulator-checked whole-body trajectory using a sparse tracker with sampling-based command optimization. This generated trajectory directly determines the onboard camera poses used to synthesize corresponding robot-view observations. The motion, observations, and task instruction form a canonical record. For each deployment controller, KODA optimizes commands to track the stored motion and records the corresponding action labels and proprioceptive states. When switching controllers, KODA retains this canonical record and regenerates whole-body state-action supervision for co-training with matching robot demonstrations. We evaluate KODA on four Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks using two whole-body controllers, SONIC and HEFT. With robot data held fixed, macro-average success on conditions covered by human demonstrations but absent from robot data improves by 45.0 and 46.25 percentage points, respectively. Under both controllers, this metric shows an upward trend across the evaluated human-data budgets, suggesting potential for further scaling.

papers.title_en: CoViG: Coarsened Vision GNN for Image Classification
papers.authors: Martial Guidez, Stefan Duffner, Christophe Garcia
papers.evidence: 图粗化降低视觉GNN计算量的高效结构
papers.tldr: 视觉图网络ViG在图像分类上精度突出，但推理计算成本较高。CoViG将图粗化引入ViG，在中间块的Grapher中加入MinCUT池化，简化图并减少节点。在ImageNet多种ViG架构上精度与原模型相当，FLOPs仅约51%。这表明图粗化可在保持精度的同时显著降低视觉图网络推理开销。
papers.abstract_en: Although Graph Neural Networks are widely used in various domains, they remained mostly unexplored in computer vision. Convolutional Neural Networks and Vision Transformers were leading the field, until the quite recent introduction of Vision Graphs (ViG) that treat images as a set of nodes and apply graph convolution on their k-NN graphs. ViGs show impressive accuracy on image classification but their computational cost remains relatively high. Inspired by optimization methods for GNNs, we present CoViG, a novel approach combining graph coarsening and ViGs. Our method introduces an additional MinCUT pooling step within the Grapher component of intermediate ViG blocks. By simplifying the intermediate graphs and thus decreasing the number of nodes of specific blocks, our approach considerably reduces the computational cost of ViG during inference. We evaluated our approach on ImageNet with several ViG architectures, and we obtained accuracies equivalent to the original ViG models with only about 51\% of FLOPs.

papers.title_en: Q($γ_H$): Entropy-Guided Horizon Mixing in Multi-Discount Q-Learning
papers.evidence: 多折扣Q学习与自适应时域混合
papers.tldr: 固定折扣因子让Q学习始终采用单一规划视野，难以兼顾早期探索与长期信用分配。Q(γ_H)维护多个折扣专用头，并用熵导出的置信信号在控制时自适应混合。策略置信度提升时，控制从短视野头转向长视野头，且不改变各Bellman更新。在延迟信用任务上相对强固定折扣基线提升最明显，提供轻量自适应规划视野控制。
papers.abstract_en: A fixed discount factor in Q-learning imposes a single planning horizon throughout training, despite the differing demands of early exploration and long-term credit assignment. We propose Q($γ_H$), a multi-horizon Q-learning framework that maintains multiple discount-specific heads and adaptively combines them at control time using an entropy-derived confidence signal. The resulting state-dependent mixing weights shift control from shorter- to longer-horizon heads as policy confidence increases, enabling adaptive horizon mixing without modifying individual Bellman updates. Across classical control and deep reinforcement-learning benchmarks, Q($γ_H$) shows its strongest improvements on delayed-credit tasks relative to strong fixed-discount baselines. By decoupling horizon adaptation from the underlying learning updates, Q($γ_H$) provides a lightweight framework for adaptive planning-horizon control in reinforcement learning, avoiding the need for manual discount-factor selection while remaining compatible with standard value-learning methods.

papers.authors: Conor Mc Gartoll, An Dang, Pranay Thangeda, Arjun Gupta, Carolina Higuera, Nima Fazeli, Mustafa Mukadam, Manikantan Nambi
papers.evidence: 强化学习仿真到真实的人形机器人全身操作
papers.tldr: 现有仿人灵巧操作多局限于末端执行器和简单抓取，难以像人一样用躯干与手臂支撑和滑动大物体。WBD将机器人身体和附肢作为接触面，先仿真生成全身抓取数据集，训练强化学习专家并蒸馏为单一策略。蒸馏策略零样本迁移到Unitree G1，可搬运篮球和纸箱并完成长程收纳任务，真实任务成功率90%，显著高于重定向18%和通用全身控制器4%。
papers.abstract_en: Current humanoid dexterous manipulation remains largely confined to end-effectors and simple grasps, falling short of humans' ability to engage the entire body by bracing and sliding bulky objects against the arms and torso. We introduce Whole-Body Dexterity (WBD), a general framework that uses the robot's body and appendages as contact surfaces to grasp and manipulate objects. Our sim-to-real pipeline first generates a dataset of feasible whole-body grasps, then trains reinforcement-learning experts on a general any-to-any repositioning objective by sampling initial and goal grasps from the dataset, and distills these experts into a single policy that uses proprioception and object geometry. We show that the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Unitree G1, where it repositions a basketball and a cardboard box to regions around the torso and completes a long-horizon task that stows a box under one arm, carries it from a shelf to a table, and places it. The controller operates interactively, steered by coarse motion references from a human teleoperator. Across real-world whole-body manipulation tasks, the distilled controller completes 90% of trials, compared with 18% for direct retargeting and 4% for a generalist whole-body controller.

papers.title_en: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Policy Improvement via Flow-Reversed Action Anchors
papers.authors: Carl Qi, Weijun Dong, Xiaojie Wang, Peiyi Chen, Rahul Sajnani, Mingyuan Zhang, Amy Zhang, Jose Barreiros, Manikatan Nambi, Lillian J. Ratliff, Dylan Randle
papers.evidence: 基于结构化潜动作的样本高效强化学习策略改进
papers.tldr: 通用机器人策略虽有强行为先验，但部署可靠性与吞吐仍受限于在线RL交互成本。AnchorQ利用流反转把参考行为映射为状态条件潜锚点，并在锚点周围采样粒子、以价值引导做由粗到细的策略改进。仿真与真实操作任务中，它在相同交互预算下优于后训练基线，真实成功率提升37%、仿真吞吐提升97%。该工作以结构化可细化动作表示提升样本效率，为通用策略的强化学习后训练提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Generalist robot policies offer strong behavioral priors, but achieving deployment-level reliability and throughput remains difficult. Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these policies, yet its effectiveness is constrained by the cost of online interaction. Existing methods adapt frozen flow-matching policies by treating noise space as a continuous action space. We show that this behaviorally unstructured space makes exploration inefficient, often preventing these methods from extracting meaningful learning signals on challenging tasks. We introduce AnchorQ, which enables coarse-to-fine policy improvement through a structured, refinable latent action representation. At each decision step, AnchorQ uses flow reversal to map reference behaviors to state-conditioned latent anchors, samples local particles around those anchors, and applies value-guided sampling to explore promising refinements. Our analysis shows that anchors reduce identification complexity at the cost of support bias; particle refinement trades this bias against action-class complexity; and critic accuracy determines the reliability of KL-regularized, value-guided selection. Across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, AnchorQ outperforms state-of-the-art post-training baselines in sample efficiency, delivering a 37% improvement in real-world success rate and 97% higher simulated task throughput under the same interaction budget. Additional visualizations are available on our website https://anchorq-rl.com/.

papers.title_en: RECREG: Recovery-based Shielding for Regular Safety Properties in Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence: 通过防护盾强制非马尔可夫正则安全约束的安全强化学习
papers.tldr: 强化学习部署常需满足安全与约束等形式化要求，尤其非马尔可夫正则安全性质难以保障。RecReg提出基于恢复的屏蔽框架，统一支持不同先验知识与安全保证。论文在表格设定下建立理论基础，给出严格安全性与收敛性保证。实验基于MASA-Safe-RL显示高效学习并与理论一致，且可扩展至深度RL。该工作弥补相关方法缺乏严格保证的不足，为安全强化学习提供可扩展路径。
papers.abstract_en: In many real-world scenarios we need to consider formal requirements, such as safety and constraint compliance, to deploy Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents. In this paper we introduce RecReg, a safe RL framework capable of enforcing non-Markovian regular safety properties via recovery-based shielding. RecReg is a unified approach that supports different levels of a priori knowledge and safety guarantees. The paper primarily focuses on building the theoretical foundations for RecReg in the tabular setting, providing rigorous safety and convergence guarantees that are not present in related work. We provide an extensive set of empirical results using the MASA-Safe-RL library, and we outline an extension of RecReg to deep RL domains using SOTA model-based RL. Our empirical results demonstrate that RecReg achieves efficient learning and matches the theory in this paper.

papers.title_en: LLM Value Functions for Credit Assignment in Agentic RL
papers.authors: Kaijie Zhu, Weixiang Yan, Omar Attia, Abbas Kazerouni, Alexander Toshev, Andrew Szot
papers.evidence: 强化学习中用于信用分配的价值函数估计
papers.tldr: 长程LLM智能体RL受稀疏结果奖励困扰，动作级信用分配困难。LVRL利用预训练LLM的上下文学习估计策略感知状态价值，无需微调独立critic，并用组上下文和首尾已知值校准，以价值差实现步级信用分配。在AppWorld、BabyAI和SWE-bench Verified上，LVRL在4B至32B规模稳定优于GRPO和PPO，AppWorld最高提升13.6个百分点，BabyAI从完全失败升至75.0%成功。该工作证明冻结LLM价值函数能提取稳健步级信用，并扩展为LVOPD改进专家蒸馏。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents remains challenging in long-horizon tasks with sparse outcome rewards, where assigning credit to individual actions is difficult. Methods such as GRPO assign the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, while critic-based methods require learning an additional value function that can be costly and unstable. We introduce LLM Value Function RL (LVRL), which uses the pretrained knowledge and in-context learning ability of an LLM to estimate policy-aware state values without finetuning a separate critic. LVRL conditions the value model on group context and calibrates its predictions using known values at the initial and terminal states, enabling step-level credit assignment from estimated value differences. We further extend this idea to learning from an expert policy through on-policy distillation (OPD), introducing LLM Value Function OPD (LVOPD), which focuses teacher supervision on actions associated with decreases in estimated value. We evaluate our approach across diverse agentic benchmarks: AppWorld, BabyAI, and SWE-bench Verified. Across policy scales (4B to 32B), LVRL consistently and substantially outperforms both GRPO and PPO. On AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified, LVRL yields absolute improvements of up to 13.6 and 8.6 percentage points over GRPO. Notably, on tasks requiring extended exploration like BabyAI, LVRL bridges the gap from total failure to 75.0% success. Furthermore, LVOPD yields consistent improvements over standard distillation baselines on AppWorld. Finally, Monte-Carlo analysis confirms that our frozen critic accurately identifies semantic pitfalls and recoveries, proving that LVRL extracts robust, policy-aware step-level credit from sparse terminal outcomes.

papers.title_en: Sea-Net: A Small and Inherently Interpretable Neural Network for Time Series Classification
papers.evidence: 轻量高效的神经网络结构设计
papers.tldr: 针对时间序列分类模型缺乏时间可解释性且现有MILLET参数量约424K、难以部署于微控制器的问题，提出轻量级SEA-Net。它采用小规模多尺度深度可分离卷积编码器与改进的多实例学习池化头，并提供瓶颈编码器+Top-k和门控编码器+Top-k两种变体。在仅41K/62K参数下分别取得0.931/0.955准确率与0.765/0.750 NDCG@n解释分数。结果表明轻量架构可在显著压缩模型的同时兼顾分类性能与时间解释，适合资源受限边缘设备。
papers.abstract_en: Traditional time-series classification methods often operate as black boxes, providing a class prediction without indicating which time point or time interval within the series led to that prediction. To improve temporal interpretability, MILLET (Multiple Instance Learning with Temporal Explanation), which combines an InceptionTime encoder with Conjunctive Pooling, provides both classification and temporal explanations. However, MILLET contains approximately 424 K parameters, making it unsuitable for deployment on resource-constrained micro-controllers, and it achieves an overall time-series accuracy of 0.888 and an explanation score of 0.681 NDCG@n. We therefore propose SEA-Net, a lightweight architecture using small multi-scale depthwise-separable convolutional TSC encoders and improved Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) pooling heads. Our SEA-Net bottleneck encoder with Top-k pooling achieves 0.931 accuracy and 0.765 NDCG@n with only 41 K parameters. Another variant, using a gated encoder with Top-k pooling, achieves 0.955 accuracy and 0.750 NDCG@n with 62 K parameters. These results demonstrate that lightweight architectures can maintain strong classification performance and temporal explanations while substantially reducing model size. The proposed variants address specific limitations of the pooling strategy used by MILLET, providing a practical direction for interpretable time-series classification on resource-constrained edge devices.

papers.title_en: RoboFQE: Rollout-Free Evaluation of Visual Robot Policies from Offline Trajectories
papers.authors: Yunfu Deng, Sangwoo Shin, Brahma S. Pavse, Josiah P. Hanna
papers.evidence: 拟合Q评估估计折扣回报与价值
papers.tldr: 机器人策略部署前评估常依赖真实执行、仿真或世界模型生成新轨迹，基础设施成本高且预测误差会累积。RoboFQE将拟合Q评估与预训练视觉基础模型、学习式终止成功标注结合，直接从离线轨迹估计目标策略折扣回报，无需行为策略密度。仿真与真机实验显示其回报估计准确并保持策略排序，长时程任务优于受自回归误差影响的视频世界模型评估器。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating robot policies before deployment typically requires producing new trajectories through real-world execution, simulators, or learned world models. These rollout-based approaches impose infrastructure requirements; simulator and world-model evaluators additionally face prediction errors that can compound over the evaluation horizon. In this paper, we study off-policy evaluation as an alternative to rollout-based robot-policy evaluation methods. Specifically, we introduce RoboFQE, an evaluator that estimates the discounted expected return of a target policy from offline robot trajectories without estimating a behavior-policy density, combining fitted Q-evaluation with a pretrained vision foundation model and learned terminal success annotation to bridge the gap between standard OPE benchmarks and continuous-control visual manipulation. Controlled experiments across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that RoboFQE produces accurate discounted-return estimates and preserves policy rankings even on long-horizon manipulation tasks where video world-model evaluators are degraded by autoregressive prediction errors. Ablation experiments show that pretrained vision encoders substantially outperform from-scratch alternatives, particularly on long-horizon tasks, and that learned terminal success annotation enables evaluation without ground-truth reward labels with only slight reduction of accuracy.

papers.evidence: 用于强化学习稳定策略优化的策略提取方法
papers.tldr: 强化学习有望超越示范数据，但实际训练常不稳定且对超参敏感；监督学习稳定可扩展，却受示范质量限制。本文提出优势引导（Advantage Guidance）：保留带优势条件的监督式策略提取结构，并在采样阶段加入对比扩散引导。该方法显著提升策略对条件优势信号的响应能力，并可逼近 KL 正则化最优策略。在 26 个长时程、稀疏奖励任务上，它显著优于此前最先进的强化学习方法。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) holds the promise of learning a policy that can outperform what is shown in the data. However, in practice, such systems suffer from instability and hyperparameter sensitivity. In contrast, supervised learning provides a stable and scalable training objective, but is fundamentally limited by the quality of the demonstrated behavior. In this paper, we ask whether we can perform policy optimization with something as simple and stable as supervised learning but as performant as RL. Unfortunately, naively training the policy with supervised learning and conditioning on future rewards or advantages typically underperform dedicated RL methods. We introduce a new policy extraction method, Advantage Guidance, that retains the simple supervised learning structure with advantage conditioning while outperforming prior RL methods through effective conditional training and contrastive diffusion guidance during sampling. We show that Advantage Guidance can significantly improve a model's ability to respond to conditional advantage signals, and the contrastive guidance during sampling can use the learned advantage-conditioned policy to target the KL-regularized optimal policy. Empirically, we find that Advantage Guidance significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art RL methods on 26 long-horizon, sparse reward tasks across datasets with varying degrees of optimality.

papers.title_en: Learning from Demonstrations meets Symbolic Control - A Supervisory Control Architecture for Formal Certification of Learned Motion
papers.authors: Ashok Kumar, Mahathi Anand, Angela Schoellig, Abdalla Swikir
papers.evidence: 对学习运动进行安全与约束认证的监督控制
papers.tldr: 基于动态系统（DS）的学习演示方法虽能生成灵活的机器人运动，但现有安全与收敛保证依赖证书生成。本文提出符号监督控制架构，从机器人动力学自动生成故障安全备份计划，独立于学习到的DS，对安全性、可达性和执行器可行性进行形式化认证。名义控制器跟踪学习DS，监督控制器监测安全与目标收敛并在必要时非保守介入。仿真与真实机器人实验覆盖多种2D/3D数据集，验证了复杂动态环境下为学习运动提供形式化保证的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamical system (DS)-based learning from demonstration generates flexible robot motions, but existing guarantees rely on certificate generation to obtain formal guarantees of safety and goal convergence. We propose a symbolic supervisory control architecture that automatically generates a fail-safe backup plan, certifying safety, reachability, and actuator feasibility directly from the robot's dynamics, independent of the learned DS. A nominal controller tracks the learned DS, while the supervisory controller monitors safety and target convergence, providing non-conservative intervention when the nominal controller violates necessary constraints. Experimental results include simulations and real robot deployment with various 2D and 3D datasets, including handwriting datasets, validating the effectiveness of our approach in providing formal guarantees with learned motion even in complex, dynamic environments.

papers.title_en: On the Convergence of Semi-Gradient TD: A Mean Field Perspective
papers.authors: Haruki Settai, Tadashi Kozuno, Shinji Ito
papers.evidence: 时序差分学习的价值函数收敛性分析
papers.tldr: 半梯度时序差分是强化学习的关键算法，但函数逼近中的自举会产生非保守向量场，常导致训练不稳定。本文在平均场极限下研究两层神经网络，发现熵诱导的松弛效应可压过移动自举目标的敏感性，从而形成稳定机制。作者在此条件下证明算法指数收敛到唯一不动点，并给出其相对无正则Bellman解的偏差刻画。该结果还通过soft Q-learning扩展到熵正则离策略控制，为理解TD稳定性提供理论依据。
papers.abstract_en: Semi-gradient temporal-difference learning is a core algorithmic component of reinforcement learning, but bootstrapping with function approximation generally induces a non-conservative vector field and can lead to instability. We analyze this effect for two-layer neural networks in the mean-field regime and identify a simple stability mechanism in which entropy-induced relaxation dominates the sensitivity of the moving bootstrap target. Under this condition, we prove exponential convergence to a unique fixed point and quantify its bias relative to the unregularized Bellman solution. We also show that the same mechanism extends to entropy-regularized off-policy control through soft Q-learning.

papers.title_en: Manifold Generative Annealing for Contact Constraint-aware Impedance Control with Reinforcement Learning Prior
papers.authors: Zhilin He, Guoquan Qi, Changliu Liu
papers.evidence: 结合RL先验与接触约束的阻抗控制
papers.tldr: 接触丰富机器人任务在交互动力学不确定和物理约束下需协调运动与阻抗，现有学习策略易受接触条件偏移影响。MGA将预训练强化学习策略组织为结构化序列提议，并通过模型rollout评估与流形精炼联合优化运动—阻抗。实验在表面扫描、插孔和人形推挤中提升标称与传感偏移下的阻抗控制安全成功率。该方法为接触约束感知的在线自适应提供了无模型与模型结合的新框架。
papers.abstract_en: Contact-rich robotic tasks require coordinated motion and impedance under uncertain interaction dynamics and physical constraints. While recent methods on learned policies provide useful interaction strategies, they may fail when contact conditions differ from those encountered during training. Model-based generative methods show promising receding-horizon trajectories optimization results, but often lack structured behavioral guidance and refinement that jointly accounts for constraint geometry and actual contact responses. To this end, we propose Manifold Generative Annealing (MGA), a joint model-free and model-based generative framework for motion--impedance optimization. MGA first organizes pretrained reinforcement learning policies into structured sequence proposals, retaining task-specific interaction strategies without committing to their execution. It then evaluates these proposals alongside exploratory samples through model-based rollouts for refinement or separate execution selection. Crucially, realization-aware manifold refinement aligns updates from the refinement bank with both task constraints and locally achievable physical responses, allowing learned experience to guide online adaptation under changing contact conditions. Experiments cover surface scanning, peg insertion, and humanoid pushing, with improved safety success rate of impedance control under nominal and sensing-shift conditions.
